call_purpose: You contacted us because your coupon code was not applying at checkout for the Advanced Course, you saw an "Invalid coupon" message, your invoice showed the wrong company name in the GST part, and you wanted to extend the coupon's expiry date.
objective: To get the coupon working on the Advanced Course, have the invoice company name corrected, and extend the coupon's expiry date.

resolved.text: Following our guidance, you added the Advanced Course in the coupon's Products section and saved it, and you confirmed the discount now shows at checkout.

covered.text: We explained that the coupon was assigned only to the Starter Course in the coupon dashboard, not to the Advanced Course, which is why the product needed to be assigned.
We explained that you can extend the expiry date yourself in the coupon settings, where the date option is available.

customer_next_steps.text: Extend the coupon's expiry date in the coupon settings.

support_next_steps.text: We will check with our billing team about the wrong company name in the GST part of your invoice, which is not yet corrected, and let you know.
support_next_steps.timeline: by the day after our call

technical_details.text: Coupon edit, Products section, Advanced Course; expiry date option in the coupon settings.
